description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'MainTabs' that manages a bottom navigation bar with different tabs, including Tasks, Projects, Tags, Dashboard, and Settings. It includes logic for switching tabs, rendering app bar and floating action button, and dispatching a notification to trigger actions within nested pages.

classes.name: MainTabs
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides bottom navigation with multiple tabs including Tasks, Projects, Tags, Dashboard, Settings.

classes.name: _MainTabsState
classes.description: State class managing the current tab index, building the scaffold with app bar, body, FAB, and bottom navigation bar.

classes.name: _TabInfo
classes.description: A simple data class holding the title, icon, and content widget for each tab.

classes.name: _ComingSoon
classes.description: A StatelessWidget displaying a 'coming soon' message for placeholder tabs.

classes.name: TasksFabTapNotification
classes.description: A Notification class to facilitate communication from MainTabs to inner TasksPage when FAB is pressed.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for MainTabs widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree with Scaffold, AppBar, body, FAB, and BottomNavigationBar.

methods.name: _tabs
methods.description: Returns a list of _TabInfo objects representing each tab, with Tasks linking to TasksPage and others as placeholders.
